where: Pearlmoor's outskirts — the allotment hill behind the quay and Pearlmoor Point (the Old Light headland)
mood: Low tide, lantern strings — the quay waltz late and quiet, a lonely-but-cosy sway on the edge of town.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
soft accordion-like pulse-wave lead with a lilting waltz melody
sparse bell-buoy chimes ringing into the gaps
slow rocking waltz bass, root then gentle fifths
seaside town late at night, lanterns swaying between masts, wistful and lonely but cosy

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a gentle waltz call on the night air: a lone bell-buoy chime, then the accordion lead sways in with the first rising phrase of the waltz and leans onto the home chord, leading into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the waltz melody in D minor, bare and swaying, the rising lift landing on each downbeat and settling back over beats two and three; hummable and clear}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same waltz again with a soft flute counter-line answering each phrase, strings a little fuller, the bells ringing into the gaps}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a warmer turn to F major, like a lit window up on the hill, the melody rising higher and kinder, then drifting back down toward the minor}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the waltz returns in D minor, calm and swaying; the last bar sways straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
